sources.title: Who actually sells payroll to agricultural employers
sources.snippet: AgriPay and HarvestHR are the two software vendors built specifically for agricultural payroll, and together they hold an estimated 6-9% of agricultural employers. The majority of farm employers obtain payroll either bundled with a farm-management ERP or through a professional employer organisation. Surveys of buying processes find that a specialist payroll vendor appears in a minority of evaluations; the common shortlist is the incumbent farm-management ERP against a PEO.

sources.title: Farm-management ERP payroll modules
sources.snippet: The leading farm-management ERP platforms ship payroll modules that handle hourly and, in recent releases, piece-rate pay. Coverage of H-2A wage-rate requirements varies and is the most frequently cited gap. Because the module is bundled with a system the farm office already operates, it is adopted by default rather than selected.

sources.title: PEOs in agriculture
sources.snippet: Professional employer organisations serving agriculture absorb payroll, workers compensation and seasonal compliance as a service. Adoption is highest among employers running large seasonal intakes, which is the same profile that experiences the most acute payroll complexity.

sources.title: No published win-rate data exists for this category
sources.snippet: No independent source publishes head-to-head win rates for agricultural payroll vendors. Vendor-reported win rates in adjacent categories have been found to describe only the deals a vendor was invited into, which excludes the decisions where no specialist was shortlisted at all.
